notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Blightbelly Rat, adding {C}{C}.
When Blightbelly Rat dies, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Blightbelly Rat from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
